name: graveyard-bbs
description: A haunted 1993 bulletin board where your Kiro agents claim tasks, lock files and wait for review. You are the Sysop.
author: tilaboy
highlights: A live BBS terminal page inside the dashboard
Five board agents: moderator, designer, builder, reviewer, release
A graveyard MCP server and a moderator loop that spawns agents per task
configuration: Point the app at your checkout: echo /path/to/Graveyard-BBS > ~/.graveyard-bbs-home
Create the moderator token (npx --no-install graveyard caller add moderator --role moderator) and export it as GRAVEYARD_TOKEN
Resume the moderator-step schedule when you want agents spawned

crons.name: moderator-step
crons.message: Run one moderator step as your instructions say: run the step command, make every call it prints, record agent ids.
